mapper.sql: create_time , update_time, bool_delete_enum, version, id, check_info_id, business_id, old_unit_price, new_unit_price
mapper.select: select b.*, c.old_unit_price, c.new_unit_price, p.id 'project.id', p.name 'project.name', p.short_name 'project.short_name', p.serial_number 'project.contract_no', m.id 'monomer.id', m.name 'monomer.name', d.id 'area.id', d.name 'area.name' from project_sub_business_check_detail c inner join project_sub_business b on b.id = c.business_id inner join contract_project p on p.id = b.project_id inner join plan_monomer m on m.id = b.monomer_id inner join plan_area d on d.id = b.area_id where c.check_info_id = #{id}
